items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: George. George. George Bocquet. George Cobwell.

ctx.x: Was that the name of a man that owned it or?

Well, he owned a couple of them halls. He owned that, Kennies Hall, Kegas Hall. He owned a couple of them, and he had a hardy, he had a hardy, he used to run it now. I don't know if he was hitting the wood. He used to have a good crowd, I think everything was packed. That's why before he was hit, he had a swell play clown that he did too, I believe in that. George. George. George Bocquet. George Cobwell.
